verdict.rationale: Airweave's own source connections run in the background: the docs say a connection 'handles authentication and automatically syncs data', which is an ongoing, autonomous sync process. That is the only first-party background behavior; the Pipedream workflow integration is a third-party platform's automation and earns no credit, and webhooks are outbound notifications, not automations. missing for 10: user-defined automations beyond data syncing, documented sync schedule or frequency configuration, autonomous agent tasks running in the background, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: It handles authentication and automatically syncs data.
